description: EV charging locations near a point, returned in the OCPI 2.2 Location → EVSE → Connector shape (connector standard, AC/DC power type, max power in W where known, operator, opening hours, status). US and Canada from the US DOE Alternative Fuel Stations directory (ports per level, connectors, network, pricing text); elsewhere from OpenStreetMap (socket types, outputs, capacity). Static directory data: no live availability. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
